prompt: Use case: style-transfer. Asset type: existing Minecraft manufacturing GUI color-comparison preview. Input image is the EDIT TARGET. Make only a subtle color grading adjustment: reduce the saturation of the blue UI surfaces by about 20–25 percent relative to the current image, including the broad background panel, header, icon tabs, angular blue patterns, buttons, slot surrounds, and dividers. Aim for a quieter steel/graphite blue with a clear blue identity. Also gently soften the vivid cyan-blue header and active borders so they fit this reduced saturation, while staying distinct and readable. Preserve the current dark value range and contrast: do not lighten or further darken the overall interface. Preserve every gradient, subtle diagonal texture, metallic shading, angular motif, and sharp pixel-style detail. Preserve exactly the current composition, dimensions, frame, all panel/slot positions and sizes, every text glyph and number, object icons, inventory contents and player/model silhouette. Keep white text legible, amber fuel and orange task status functional, warning red distinct, and progress cyan identifiable. Keep external scenery unchanged. No re-layout, retyping, new labels, new objects, extra effects, or grayscale conversion. Return the single complete edited preview.
